title: Samsung, DB HiTek eye 8-inch foundry price hikes as AI demand surges
html:
Major semiconductor foundries using 8-inch (200mm) wafers are operating at or near full capacity and seeking further price increases as demand for power chips used in AI data centers grows and major chipmakers scale back older production lines.

Credit: Samsung
